title: Personalized Baseball Bedding Full Size Flag Custom Name D - Design 11
description:
Transform your bedroom into a celebration of America's favorite pastime with this personalized baseball bedding set from Jeminise. Perfect for baseball players and fans alike, this comforter set offers comfort, durability, and a unique way to display your passion for the game, making it an ideal gift for men, women, moms, and dads on special occasions.

Key Features

  • Meaningful Gift: Celebrate baseball enthusiasts with a thoughtful gift for men and women, moms and dads, perfect for Valentine's, Mother's, Father's Day, and Christmas.
  • Available Sizes: Choose from US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88") to fit various bed dimensions.
  • Superior Manufacturing Process: Environmentally friendly finishing techniques ensure the fabric retains dye, preventing fading, with smooth, fine, and compact stitching for lasting enjoyment.
  • Material Details: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric for a soft, comfy, durable, and lightweight feel, with whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping or shifting.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water and can be air-dried without heat; microfiber dries quickly and becomes fluffier after washing. For best results, wash in a mesh laundry bag.
  • Personalized Design: Features a customizable baseball theme with US Flag elements, allowing for two text inputs to add a personal touch.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Duvet Cover Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester, Cotton
Fill Material Microfiber Filling
Color Baseball Thunder
Pattern Baseball
Design Personalized Baseball Bedding Set
Included Components Duvet Cover
Customization 2 text inputs
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Special Feature Breathable
Thread Count 400
Closure Type Zipper
Pillowcase Quantity 2
